Hi there! Are you new to Voat and interested in contributing to /v/SoundboardPranks? Hopefully, this is an easy guide on how to update the subverse.

  1. Check the Masterlist of Active Pranksters. The top half of the page are pranksters that regularly post calls and the bottom half are semi-active. Note: Feel free to update the list if you know of a prankster missing from the list. The "Victims" list on the sidebar is a useful tool to find new callers.

  2. Check the Masterlist of Retired Pranksters. Most of these channels haven't been updated in years but a sometimes a new call will be posted so they should be checked once in a while. The names in bold indicate pranksters who have posted occasional calls after their "retirement".

  3. I also check out the Timeline of Soundboard Prank Calling in case of an upcoming anniversary for a popular soundboard call or event. Some of the YouTube links on the article are dead but you can usually find saved copies on SB Archive channels - most often Ima Legalfirm and SlightBloodierMargie.

  4. I try to post the calls in chronological order. The format I've used is "[Name of Prankster] Title of Call (Date)" (if the date is applicable). It's not necessary to use this exact format but I find it helpful to keep a record of a call in case a channel closes. It might be a handy resource for Soundboard.Wiki, for example, which keeps a detailed list of soundboard calls for many of its articles.

  5. Submitting a Link is pretty straightforward. Want to interact with the community? Feel free to ask a question, request a soundboard, start a poll or begin a general discussion. If you'd like to contribute anonymously, just check the box at the bottom of the page.

Hope this helps and thanks for reading.
